text: dsh-discord 是面向 DSH 的 Discord 远程控制插件，可在 Discord 私信、服务器频道和线程中与 Agent 对话。它接入 DSH 的 Agent、会话、附件、凭据和用户交互服务，并为每个 Discord 对话保存独立 Session。用户可发送自然语言、使用 /dsh help、status、new、stop、steer 命令、查看运行进度、处理审批与结构化问题，也可发送图片和文本代码附件。适合希望通过 Discord 远程继续 DSH 项目任务的个人使用。需要配置 Bot Token、Discord Owner ID 和项目目录。

dsh-discord connects Discord DMs, channels, and threads to DSH agents. It saves a session per conversation and supports task messages, /dsh controls, progress updates, approvals, questions, and image or text attachments. Requires a Discord bot token, owner ID, and project directory.
想通过 Discord 私信远程给 DSH Agent 发任务。
让我的 DSH 会话可以在 Discord 服务器频道里继续。

希望通过 Discord 消息把图片和代码文件交给 DSH。
I want to control my DSH agent from a Discord conversation.
Let me check progress and steer a running DSH task in Discord.
Discord 消息驱动 DSH Agent：私信可直接提交任务，服务器频道消息通过机器人提及触发，绑定线程可接着对话。消息会进入对应频道的 Agent 会话。
Discord 斜杠命令：/dsh status 查看会话状态，new 创建新 Session，stop 停止当前任务，steer 将补充文本排入当前任务；help 显示用法。
图片与文本附件输入：Discord 图片交给 DSH 附件服务校验并保存；文本和代码文件解码后作为消息内容提交，二进制附件会提示不支持。
审批与结构化问题交互：插件把 DSH 审批请求和用户问题呈现在 Discord，用户可通过组件选择或自定义回答，等待超时会结束交互。
dsh-discord uses Discord Gateway for messages. A Bot Token is required. (src/discord/client.ts:35)

dsh-discord README · dsh-discord：The dedicated `discord` profile supports one owner and project across DMs, guild text channels, and threads. Each Discord conversation owns an independently persisted DSH Session. Owner DMs trigger directly; ordinary guild-channel messages require an explicit bot mention; an already-bound thread continues without repeated mentions. Slash commands never require a mention.

dsh-discord README · dsh-discord：The bot invite requests View Channel, Send Messages, **Send Messages in Threads**, Read Message History, Embed Links, and Attach Files. `doctor` checks the same permission set. Discord server and channel permissions determine where the bot is visible; the plugin remains single-owner and fail-closed.

dsh-discord README · dsh-discord：The controller includes natural text, `/dsh help/status/new/stop/steer`, coalesced progress, approvals, structured questions, image and text/code attachment ingress, durable event deduplication, Gateway reconnect, and managed daemon operation.

Enable **Message Content Intent** on the Discord Developer Portal Bot page for natural guild-channel messages.

The global CLI is only a launcher. The plugin itself is activated in the dedicated `discord` profile and remains bound to the single project selected during setup; it does not become active in every directory or in the `web` profile.

The Bot Token is stored only through DSH Credentials. See [README.zh.md](README.zh.md), [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md), and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
